diagnosis: The cancellation recovery fixture was seeded with advisorActor.advisorId but executed by a different authenticated privileged identity. R20 commercial scope correctly keeps Leads own-only for an advisor-bound identity regardless of active privileged/Operativo role, so create_business for another advisor was denied. The generic downstream link assertion hid the scope denial.

authority.rule: Leads remain own-scope by advisor identity even when active role is Operativo/privileged; operational scope is separate.

qaChange.fixtureRule: Cancellation/recovery fixtures use the authenticated execution actor advisorId. The collaboration fixture remains explicitly assigned to advisorActor so handoff recipient proof is preserved.
